d:
Hello! Here's another remix thanks to AI. I'd like to upload more remixes, but the big problem is that the AI ​​sometimes fails and creates awful images. I've tried several LORAs and even created some myself, but there's still a lot of room for improvement before the AI ​​stops having problems with certain images. For example: images without color, very large breasts, faces, fluids, etc. I've already integrated LORAs with color, textures, fluids, large breasts, sexual positions, and much more. The only thing missing is for the repositories of AI manga and their respective authors to keep growing so we can get better results. Another problem is that it takes time because sometimes I have to check the parameters of each image and modify them for each one that comes out wrong (when the AI ​​has problems).

This is non-profit and, above all, to honor the respective authors.

Little by little, I'll upload content that I like.

I repeat, I will only upload content that I like, and creating it takes time.

P.S.: If you don't like it, don't watch it or create your own versions.

Regards.
